issues: Integrity: no problems found. The diff only changes the seed, the time split and the SLSQP settings, and adds a step that re-optimises the best 12 results. It adds no file or network access and no pasted coordinates. finalize() still checks every packing, so I found no bug that would make the result meaningless.

z has the wrong sign. The candidate's loss is -2.631 and the incumbent's is -2.6360, so the candidate is worse by +0.005 (higher loss). The harness reports z = -3543.183, and a negative z would mean the candidate is better. The 'reject' decision is still right, but the sign of z is not.

z cannot really be computed. There is one run on each side, so there is no measured variance. The size of the harness z (~3.5e3) matches dividing by an assumed noise of about sqrt(2)*1e-6. On that same assumption z would be about +3.5e3, not -3.5e3. Treat z as undefined (null).
Side note, not caused by this diff: the incumbent's sum of 2.6360 is above the best known 2.635. That is possible, but the incumbent's validity check is worth confirming.
On the numbers: the faster first search (maxiter 40, ftol 1e-6) and re-optimising only the top 12 did worse than the incumbent (2.631 vs 2.636). Reject.
